name: MCA V3 portal
what: Incorporate companies and LLPs (SPICe+, FiLLiP), file annual returns (AOC-4, MGT-7/7A, Form 8/11), DIN and director KYC, check company names and master data.

name: MCA name check (company/LLP master data)
what: Search existing company and LLP names before reserving yours.

name: GST portal
what: GST registration (REG-01), returns (GSTR-1/3B/9), LUT filing, refunds, e-way bill links, notices.

name: GST e-invoice portal (IRP)
what: Generate IRNs and QR codes once turnover crosses ₹5 crore; bulk tools and APIs.

name: E-way bill portal
what: Generate e-way bills for goods movements above ₹50,000 (state rules vary for intra-state).

name: Income Tax e-filing
what: PAN, ITR filing, tax audit report upload, advance tax challans, Form 26AS and AIS.

name: TRACES (TDS)
what: TDS returns, Form 16/16A, challan status, TAN-linked compliance.

name: PAN / TAN application (Protean)
what: Apply for PAN or TAN outside the SPICe+ bundle (proprietors, partnerships, trusts).

name: Udyam Registration
what: Free MSME registration using Aadhaar, PAN and GSTIN; Udyam Assist for informal micro units.

name: National Single Window System
what: One login for DPIIT startup recognition and many central and state approvals (labour, FSSAI, state incentives).

name: Startup India
what: Recognition status, 80-IAC tax-exemption application, seed fund, schemes directory, investor connect.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
what: Apply through empanelled incubators for grants up to ₹20 lakh and convertible instruments up to ₹50 lakh.

name: DGFT
what: IEC application and annual update, RCMC, e-BRC self-certification, licences and authorisations, Foreign Trade Policy.

name: ICEGATE (Customs)
what: Customs filing, AD-code registration at ports, shipping bills, bills of entry, duty calculator, RoDTEP scrips.

name: CBIC
what: Customs tariff, notifications and circulars for customs and GST.

name: FIEO
what: Umbrella export promotion council; RCMC for multi-product exporters; trade fairs and buyer-seller meets.

name: ECGC
what: Export credit insurance against buyer default and country risk.

name: IP India (trademarks, patents, designs)
what: Trademark public search, TM-A filing, status, patents and design registration.

name: Copyright Office
what: Register software, content and artistic works.

name: FoSCoS (FSSAI)
what: Food business registration and State/Central licences, renewals, annual returns.

name: Bureau of Indian Standards
what: ISI mark, Compulsory Registration Scheme for electronics, hallmarking, quality control orders.

name: Legal Metrology (Dept. of Consumer Affairs)
what: Packaged Commodities Rules, LMPC registration for importers/packers, model approval of weighing instruments.

name: CDSCO
what: Drugs, cosmetics and medical-device licensing and import registration.

name: EPFO Unified Portal (employer)
what: Employer registration, monthly ECR filing, UAN generation.

name: ESIC
what: Employer registration, monthly contributions, IP registration.

name: Shram Suvidha
what: Common registration under labour laws (EPF/ESI), Labour Identification Number, annual returns.

name: RBI FIRMS (foreign investment reporting)
what: Entity Master and FC-GPR/FC-TRS filings when you issue or transfer shares to non-residents.

name: Reserve Bank of India
what: FEMA regulations, master directions on exports/imports and ODI, payment-system licences.

name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
what: Sell goods and services to government buyers; Udyam-registered sellers get preference and exemptions.

name: ONDC
what: Open network for digital commerce; list once through a seller app and appear on many buyer apps.

name: Amazon Seller Central (India)
what: Marketplace onboarding: GSTIN, PAN, bank account, brand registry (trademark).

name: Flipkart Seller Hub
what: Marketplace onboarding and fulfilment programmes.

name: Meesho Supplier Panel
what: Zero-commission marketplace; accepts composition-scheme and, for exempt goods, unregistered sellers.

name: Amazon Global Selling
what: Export via Amazon’s 18+ marketplaces; needs IEC, AD code and a courier/CSB route.

name: e-Gazette of India
what: Official text of every notification and rule.

name: India Code
what: Consolidated text of central Acts and rules.

name: GST Council
what: Council meeting outcomes and press releases.

name: Press Information Bureau
what: Official press releases from every ministry.

name: MSME Samadhaan
what: File delayed-payment complaints against buyers who do not pay within 45 days.

name: CGTMSE
what: Collateral-free credit guarantee for micro and small enterprise loans.

name: PM MUDRA Yojana
what: Shishu/Kishore/Tarun/Tarun Plus loans up to ₹20 lakh through banks and NBFCs.

name: PMEGP (KVIC)
what: Subsidised project loans for new micro enterprises (15–35% subsidy).

name: Stand-Up India
what: ₹10 lakh–₹1 crore loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises.

name: SIDBI
what: Development bank for MSMEs; Fund of Funds for Startups operator.

name: TReDS — RXIL / M1xchange / Invoicemart
what: Discount invoices raised on large buyers for early payment.

name: STPI (SOFTEX)
what: Register as a non-STP unit to file SOFTEX forms for software/IT exports.

name: APEDA
what: Registration (RCMC) for agricultural and processed-food exporters.

name: EPCH (handicrafts)
what: Export promotion council for handicrafts; RCMC and fairs.

name: State Pollution Control Board (OCMMS)
what: Consent to Establish / Operate for manufacturing units, by state board.

name: State labour department (Shops & Establishments)
what: Shops & Establishment registration, professional tax and trade licences are state/municipal — find your department here.

name: NSIC
what: Single-point registration for government purchase, raw-material assistance.

name: MSME Champions portal
what: Grievances, schemes and handholding for MSMEs.

name: Digital Signature Certificates (CCA licensed CAs)
what: List of licensed certifying authorities for Class 3 DSCs used on MCA, GST, DGFT and income-tax portals.
